user_requested_protocol: Three independent complete proposals, then cross-discussion, then a fourth independent red-team review and existing-triangular-data validation.

independent_stage.focus: Local-singlet false positives; gapped SET versus gapless spectrum evidence
Finite regional RDM and nonlocal partial-rotation feasibility; numerical controls
Independent symmetry/anyon distinction, source provenance and exact magnetic/dimer counterexamples

cross_discussion: All three received the peer proposals and compared theoretical assumptions, sampling provenance and false-positive controls. This is a synthesis, not a verbatim transcript.

extra_limits: Odd invariant physical regions have forced pi zeros.
Transfer-sector degeneracy alone does not imply a nonzero finite-height cusp without regularity assumptions.
Born-estimator relative precision can cost exponentially in boundary length.
The 2026 partial-rotation fractionalization indicator is published prior art, not a new observable.
Full low-energy-manifold transition RDMs must include off-diagonal data and magnetic sectors; hand-picked S0/A1 states can hide order.
implementation_findings: Axis/scalar maximum compared only z; fixed to compare x and z, with a positive physical off-diagonal counterexample test.
Complex angle accepted as a rotation; fixed to require nonempty finite real angles, with regression tests.

decision: Measure signed complex partial spin rotation with quality/chain uncertainty; do not infer QSL from local weights, parity, finite zeros, log curvature, or two-axis agreement.

bounded_secondary_precision_followup.nature: Adaptive secondary analysis motivated by v1; registered before this execution, not a wholly prospective study.
